Investors

Telenet group is a multi-brand group where customer experience is at the core. We aim to make a difference in customer experience by helping customers move forward and by collaborating with partners who strengthen our capabilities. In this way, we create sustainable value with attention to economic, social, and environmental impact.

 

At holding level, Telenet group reports its financial results, debt position, and ESG policy documents, all of which are bundled and accessible on this page.
